name: Reprism
purpose: Make exercise motion observable and understandable through tracking and replay.
audience: People observing and improving their own exercise movement.

philosophies.statement: Make movement legible without visual noise.
Retain a recognizable repetition and direction motif.
Read the same movement from several viewpoints.

rules.statement: Derive the geometric study from one base unit.
Use equal stem and perpendicular diagonal widths.
Explore counter geometry derived from transformed views of one source curve.

avoid: A decorative grid unrelated to source geometry
typography: Manrope 700 in the archived wordmark study; not a generic skill default.
assumptions: The geometric R is a baseline study, not a completed multiple-viewpoint identity.
